chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, that he was asked about a man who dies and there is no one present to wash him except women. He said:
His wife, or a relative if he has one, washes him, and the women pour water over him by pouring. And regarding the woman, when she dies, her husband puts his hand beneath her shirt and washes her.

key_terms.تُغَسِّلُهُ: she washes him ritually after death
key_terms.فَيُغَسِّلُهَا: then he washes her ritually after death

ai.seo_question: Can a husband and wife perform the ghusl of each other after death?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning the washing of the deceased when only women are present. It states that a man's wife, or a relative if he has one, may wash him, and that a husband may wash his deceased wife from beneath her garment.
